label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Unique Selling Proposition (USP)
body: Your Unique Selling Proposition (USP) is what makes your product or service clearly different and better than others in your market.
caption:
Think about what makes your offering special. Is it a unique feature, a specific benefit, or a different approach to solving a problem? When you know your USP, you can clearly tell potential customers why they should choose you. This helps you stand out and attract people who really need what you offer. What makes your creation uniquely yours? 🤔
